$description: Clarion brand primitives. A brand owns only what varies per brand: its colour ramp, its font families and ONE radius base. Everything else lives in core.json. Copy this folder to add a brand.

sans.$value: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif

mono.$value: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

base.$description: The one radius knob (CSS --radius). Every radius/* step in core is a multiple of this. A brand sets this and nothing else about radius.
